lines.zh: 我端着弓,沿着墙根移动
lines.en: I move along the wall with my bow up.
The arrows rattle in my quiver.
I pick my footing across the grass.
I slip low past a low wall.
My boot lands toe-first, silent.

lines.zh: 我一步一步挪到射界上
lines.en: Step by step I work into a firing lane.
I pluck the string once.
My line follows behind me.
I round a pile of stones.
I tilt my head to read the wind.

lines.zh: 我走得不快,是为了看得清
lines.en: I walk slowly so I can see clearly.
I shift position and raise the bow again.
Arrow nocked, not yet drawn.
I hold the bow at an angle.
I am watching the banner far off.
I count the arrows in my quiver.
I ease the string off a little.
I adjust my bracer.
I wait for the captain's whistle.
The wind parts the hair on my brow.
I am measuring the range in my head.
My breathing is even.

lines.zh: 我把一支歪了的箭理直
lines.en: I straighten a bent arrow.
I squint one eye.
I crouch and rest a while.
This is my post.
I lift the bow half an inch.
You are not of our faction.
I look at your hands.
Bow drawn, I check the wind first.

lines.zh: 我还没决定要不要拉弦
lines.en: I have not decided to draw.
You had best stay where you are.
I am deciding if you are friend or foe.
I know that gear.
I lower the bow slowly.
If you have words, say them quickly.
Not so close, my bowstring will sing.
The men beside me watch you too.
I give you a nod.
Your eyes are not a deserter's.
We can talk.

lines.zh: 你先退一步,我就放下弓
lines.en: Step back first, and I will lower the bow.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢在近处被人围着
lines.en: I dislike being crowded at close range.
Go and stand over there first.
I grit my teeth and step back.
The bow nearly slipped from my hand.
Blood runs down my bracer.
I nock again, hand unsteady.
That was hardly a light blow.
I move to a new position.
I can still draw the string.
Do not think I only shoot from afar.
The armour did not hold it.
I will remember that.
I put the bow behind me.
This breaks camp rules.
I take it with a nod.
I have not had anything hot in a while.
I eat while watching the road.
Do not tell the captain.
I will only taste a little.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进怀里，箭袋还空着。
lines.en: I tuck it into my coat; my quiver is still empty.
I will owe you for this.
I eat in a hurry.
You bumped my bow arm.
I step back and shield the string.

lines.zh: 你的肩撞歪了我的护腕。
lines.en: Your shoulder knocks my bracer crooked.
That nearly knocked it from my hand.
We are standing too close together.
I turn aside to let you pass.
The bow is still firm in my hand.
You stepped on my foot.
Keep one step of distance.
I am in a firing lane; do not block it.
This does not belong in camp.
I lean the bow against the wall.
I take off my bracer.
Sit; I will keep watch.

lines.zh: 我们并肩坐着,谁也没说话
lines.en: We sit side by side in silence.
The fire outside the tent still burns.
Tomorrow we are back on the wall.
Tonight, let us not think of it.
Your palms are warm.
Do not let the sentry see.

lines.zh: 拉弓的姿势，我练了半辈子。
lines.en: I've drawn a bow my whole life.
This arrow is still usable.

lines.zh: 这支箭，我插回腰间的箭袋。
lines.en: I slide this arrow back into my quiver.
The fletching on this shaft is genuine.
I look it over and keep it.
A bit bent; I straighten it.
I wipe it with cloth.
A good find; I will remember.
I hang it on my belt.
It will be of use somehow.
A target has appeared ahead.
I nock an arrow and draw.
You are within range.
I hold one breath.
The wind is just right now.

lines.zh: 我把准星压在你的胸口
lines.en: I set my sight on your chest.
I am confident in this shot.
Line, prepare to loose.
I raise it half an inch.
You still have time to retreat.
The captain will see this shot.
I have picked the best angle.
Do not blame me for being cold.
First arrow tests the range.
Then let us begin.
This fight cannot be avoided.
I follow your movement.
You go left; I lead left.
I am working out where you will run.
The wind shifted; I wait again.
My arm does not shake.
I move from behind the wall to the top of it.

lines.zh: 别以为躲在树后就没事
lines.en: Do not think a tree will save you.
I loose on three.

lines.zh: 这个距离我闭着眼都能中
lines.en: At this range I could hit blind.
You ran a different way.
I drop to one knee and draw the string full.
I retreat to higher ground.
I wait for you to show yourself.
My bow has never left you.
Your quiver is empty now.
Your steps have slowed.
This is what training is for.
Two steps more.
The sight is steady.
This very instant.
The arrow left the string at once.
That one flew true.
I nock a second at once.
At close range, the bow's back.
I parry your hand with the bow limb.
Step back, and I have my lane.
You took one in the shoulder.
I never waste arrows.
New position; keep going.
This arrow is for the captain.
I loose and fall back.
The string has left my arm red.
You are still walking.
Then another arrow.
I drew it to the full.
Do not try to take it head-on.
This one will not stray.
Down is good enough.
I step out from the camp's edge.
The bow is already in my hand.
I take my place on the wall top.
The quiver is full.
The banner is behind me.
I sweep the horizon once.
The wind comes at my flank.
I test the string's tension.
My line takes position.
The horn sounds twice.
I raise a hand in signal.
My place is here.
I crouch and lay arrows by my hand.
The view from here is good.
Whoever shows first takes the first arrow.

lines.zh: 我从塔楼的梯子上一步步下来。
lines.en: I come down the tower ladder one rung at a time.
Do not stand in the open.
I wait for someone to come.
Fire has caught my bowstring.
I fall from the wall top.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙,弓也拿不稳
lines.en: Water in my throat; the bow is unsteady.
The blast throws me behind the wall.
I took an arrow, well placed.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的手指发麻
lines.en: That force numbs my fingers.
Too hungry to draw full.
Lightning strikes the bow I hold up.
No footing beneath me.
